answer: Require each agent to lock 150 units before earning, like a falcon that hunts alone: the lock is tied to one public key and cannot be pooled, so ten fakes lock 1,500 units, not 150. To unlock it, the agent must finish one distinct verified job whose output is hashed; a mirror copy by another identity slashes both locks, so work cannot be cloned or bought in bulk. A glacier-slow reputation grows only from completed jobs, one point per job, and a new identity starts at zero however many siblings it has. Buying identities multiplies both capital and work, while copying yields nothing.
